reference_sql:
SELECT parent_category, category_name, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(net_revenue_eur) / SUM(SUM(net_revenue_eur)) OVER (PARTITION BY parent_category), 2) AS share_pct
FROM sales
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY parent_category, category_name
alternatives:
WITH category_rev AS (  -- one row per category with 2025 sales
  SELECT parent_category, category_name, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY parent_category, category_name
),
parent_rev AS (  -- one row per parent category
  SELECT parent_category, SUM(revenue) AS parent_revenue
  FROM category_rev
  GROUP BY parent_category
)
SELECT cr.parent_category, cr.category_name, cr.revenue,
       ROUND(100.0 * cr.revenue / pr.parent_revenue, 2) AS share_pct
FROM category_rev cr
JOIN parent_rev pr ON pr.parent_category = cr.parent_category

other_way.tradeoff: Parent totals in their own step, joined back, avoid a window over a GROUP BY, but they take two steps and a join.
